whyItMatters: Without the Secure flag the browser may send the cookie over unencrypted HTTP, where network attackers can steal it. Cookie values were not inspected.
actions: Set Secure on every cookie served over HTTPS.
Add HttpOnly unless JavaScript must read the cookie, and choose an explicit SameSite policy.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the flags are observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes Secure on the target's cookies.
